string.text: I have recruited and trained fine warriors. I could gift some to you, to defend this settlement and protect your interests. What say you?
Of course, that could help us a lot here.
This text should be under the party screen.
You have sold your troops for {GOLD} gold.
You are helping to rebuild the village.
I am in need of funds. Given our good standing, could you provide some financial backing?
Of course. You've been a good friend to us. Here is what we can spare.
How much gold would you like to donate to the people? (You can type 'max' to donate the maximum possible amount based on your purse and the settlement limit).
The settlement has already reached its maximum capacity for your donations.
You received {GOLD} gold. Your relation with {NAME} decreased by {COST}.
You donated {GOLD} gold and increased {NAME}'s hearths by {AMOUNT}.
You donated {GOLD} gold and increased {NAME}'s prosperity by {AMOUNT}.
You helped rebuild {NAME}. Relations with local notables increased by +50.
